outcome_rules.content_reminder: recovered when the target key point is mentioned
outcome_rules.next_point_suggestion: recovered when the target key point is mentioned
outcome_rules.silence_recovery: recovered when speech resumes (and the cue is mentioned, if it had one)
outcome_rules.pace_adjustment: recovered when the rate returns within 15% of typical; partial when it moves toward typical
outcome_rules.repetition_alert: recovered when fillers drop to the typical level without the repeated phrase
outcome_rules.clarification_suggestion: recovered when audience confusion falls to 0.4 or below; partial when it drops
outcome_rules.question_reinterpretation: recovered when the answer contains the expected answer keywords
outcome_rules.answer_structure: recovered when the answer contains the expected answer keywords
outcome_rules.time_management: recovered when the presenter advances a slide or the time budget improves
outcome_rules.wrap_up: recovered when the presenter reaches the final slide
